location: South Bend Civic Theater | 403 N Main St | South Bend, 46601
description:

Willful and temperamental in life and death, Elvira proceeds to create hilarious, haunting havoc as she attempts to sabotage Charles’s relationship with his current wife, Ruth, through a series of increasingly chaotic events.

title: FILM: "FANTASIA" (1940)
location: DeBartolo Performing Arts Center
description: Professor Pfinklepfunder's $1 Sunday Films Directed by James Algar, Samuel Armstrong, Ford Beebe Jr., et al. With Leopold Stokowski, Deems Taylor Rated G, 124 minutes An anomaly in the canon of Disney animated features, Fantasia holds a special place in many hearts and memories for its vibrant colors and, at times, plotless abstract pieces. Composed of eight different segments featuring classical music, the anthology of animated shorts act as their own music videos of sorts—an odd way for Mickey Mouse to star in his first feature film, but a timeless example copied by many on how animation and music can be woven into inspiration. GET TICKETS *Sponsored by the Meg and John P. Brogan Endowment for Classic Cinema.

title: FREE ARTIST AND CAREER BUILDING WORKSHOP FOR MUSICIANS
location: The Music Village | 333 S Michigan St | South Bend, IN 46601
description:
Interested in artist development or building a career in music? This workshop is for you!

Presented by The Music Village and Jireh Music - open to all ages, all instruments, and all playing levels.

This FREE 60 minute workshop offers musicians a rare chance to learn from and interact with a chart-topping music industry professional. Led by drummer, composer, and Billboard Top 40 recording artist, Travis Brant, this engaging workshop transforms the art of musical creativity into practical, easy-to-use skills that inspire and equip musicians at every level.

Discussion topics include Building Foundations (mastering fundamentals, practice routine, listening skills, musical roles), Career Building (how to become a professional, networking, habits of the pros, career options in music), Artist Development (music business, writing / recording / releasing music) and time for Q&A.

Expand your skills, gain knowledge, learn about the music business, careers in music, and much more!

The Music Village is a community musical arts center and school, celebrating music and cultural expressions rooted in the traditions of diverse local and global communities in the heart of downtown South Bend, Indiana.

Jireh Music is a nonprofit music program providing artist and career development through education, mentoring, and support resources.

Travis Brant is an American drummer, composer, co-founder of the band Axon Radio, and Billboard / Mediabase top 40 recording artist. Travis' recorded works include collaborations with contemporary jazz icons Gerald Albright, Michael Lington, Darren Rahn, Paul Brown, fusion guitarist Oz Noy, and more.

title: SCAVENGER HUNT AT THE MORRIS
location: The Morris Performing Arts Center | 211 N Michigan St | South Bend, IN 46601
description:
Experience the Morris Performing Arts Center like never before! Join Connect 574 for an interactive scavenger hunt that takes you behind the scenes and throughout the venue as you solve clues and discover fascinating facts about the historic building.

Whether you’re a first-time visitor or a longtime patron, this adventure is a great way to connect with others and learn more about a defining South Bend landmark. Gather your own team or have us create one for you, put your detective skills to the test, and see if you can complete the hunt before time runs out!

Where: Morris Performing Arts Center

When: August 21 at 6:30

Event Highlights:

No awkward intros: we’ll introduce you to your team and help break the ice – or if you’d like to sign up with friends, that’s okay too!

Get to know a South Bend landmark: The Morris has been part of our skyline for over 100 years, and has a lot of fascinating history inside.

Welcome hour: We’ll have a cash bar for you to get comfortable when you come in!
